summary: Found during MPI-365 live verification: a SAM3 detection is auto-selected and unioned into maskCanvas, so an un-Added pick is injected as Input_Mask. The green overlay must stay a preview - the user may want to Subtract it. Reverses the MPI-372/MPI-384 contract, so the op strip must be re-gated on baked content instead.

Filed under the MPI-440 canvas-family umbrella #2 (mask and paint parity). Order, standing constraints and the shared alpha-vs-luminance decision are in tasks/MPI-440/brief.md - read it before starting this card.

First member of MPI-440. Reverses the MPI-372/384 decision that a detection puts real pixels in maskCanvas: exec.onMasks calls setSelectedAutoPicks + evaluateMask, MaskManager composites picks into the mask, so an un-Added preview ships into Input_Mask. The op strip must be re-gated on BAKED content in the same pass or MPI-372 returns.

Code complete, probe-verified, docs updated. Root cause: maskCanvas answered two questions at once - what is on screen and what gets sent - because _recomposite() unioned selectedAutoPicks into it. Fix is a DELETION: drop that union, and all 12 hasMaskContent(maskCanvas) sites plus getURL() became baked-only for free. Twin _buildCompositeFromTemp() fixed in the same pass (it fed _previewMaskCache -> getCurrentMaskDataURL, the second door). Display verified pixel-identical - autoCanvas already drew green on top and that recolour is opaque. USER DECISION: op strip gates on baked content, so a bare detection leaves masked ops locked until Add; this needed NO new code since _opOptions() already reads hasMask(). Rejected the alternative (unlock on detection) because it would offer a masked op while the mask sent was empty. Proof: 12/12 real-pixel probe in Chromium against the live MaskManager, with a sabotage control that failed exactly the two bug assertions; 392/392 node suite; eslint 0. NOT verified: no live click-through of detect-then-Add in the app.

USER-VALIDATED live in the app 2026-08-04: a detection no longer enters the mask, and the masked ops stay locked until Add. Fix was a deletion in MaskManager._recomposite() plus its twin _buildCompositeFromTemp(); op-strip re-gating came free because _opOptions() already read hasMask(). Shipped in f64fc75e. First member of the MPI-440 umbrella; next is MPI-421 on the same exec.onMasks path.
Archived out of board.columns.done to .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/_archived/MPI-426/ (workspace preserved intact). mpi-archive run 2026-08-04.
